corpus.declaration: Hold on, scratch that — i don't poke at the room. i'm up, boots on, back to the wet stone wall the way i settled it, and the first thing i do is a plain kit check with the blade already in my hand — thumb along the edge, eye on the point and the guard, and i pick exactly one weapon for what's ahead. one. the one with the true edge, the one i can put where i want it in the dark without a light. self-correction: not the wide lamp trick, not a second knife tucked somewhere clever, not a chair leg or a wedge swung like a club — just the one blade, one grip, edge where my thumb says it is. i say it low to myself, the same word for it, then i set my hand the way i'll actually hold it and hold it there. after that i go back to the door i wedged and put my ear to the frame and listen first — i want the first move to be mine, not the dark's.
